Guided Whale Watching Tour from Long Beach
(168 Reviews)
 Code: LA-12703
 Day Tour
 Los Angeles
What To Expect
Overview
Custom high-speed whale watching vessels covering a wide marine area for better sightings.
Aquarium educators onboard for enriching marine knowledge.
Sealife Guarantee: Free return voucher if no marine life is seen.
Multiple restrooms, climate-controlled interiors, and comfortable seating.
Wheelchair and stroller accessible, suitable for all fitness levels.
Itinerary
01
Day 1
Harbor Breeze Cruises Dock #2

Meet at designated meeting point: Harbor Breeze Cruises Our ticket booth is located at Dock #2 across the street from Bubba Gump Shrimp Restaurant and between the Aquarium of the Pacific and Hooters Restaurant. Please arrive with your Viator order and we will print every one in your party physical tickets to board the vessel.

Activities & Attractions: Queen Mary Spa & Salon (Free entry How to visit:No indoor visits) Our vessel will pass by the world famous Queen Mary while departing and coming back from your whale watching cruise

We will travel out into the open Pacific Ocean to search for amazing marine life including Whales, Dolphins, Sea Lions, rare Marine Birds, and much more!

Activities & Attractions: Aquarium of the Pacific (Free entry How to visit:No indoor visits) One of the top attractions in Long Beach with a collection of over 11,000 animals, over 500 different species. You can enjoy animal encounters.

Activities & Attractions: Carnival Cruise Terminal - Long Beach (Free entry How to visit:No indoor visits) Cruise Ship Terminal

Activities & Attractions: Carnival Cruise Terminal - Long Beach (Free entry How to visit:No indoor visits) Once Home of the Spruce Goose, a massive, wooden flying boat designed and built by Howard Hughes during World War II

Activities & Attractions: Port of Long Beach (Free entry How to visit:No indoor visits) Part of the largest commercial port in the world

One of the largest Breakwater's in the USA.

Allow guests to leave on their own: Harbor Breeze CruisesEnd the tour on your own and bring your trip to a happy conclusion Our ticket booth is located at Dock #2 across the street from Bubba Gump Shrimp Restaurant and between the Aquarium of the Pacific and Hooters Restaurant. Please arrive with your Viator order and we will print every one in your party physical tickets to board the vessel.

 Things to Know
Arrive at least 30 minutes to 1 hour before departure to redeem for boarding passes.
Itinerary order and stops may be subject to change.

Things to Know
Included/Exclude
Low emission engines for eco-friendly cruising.
2 to 2.5-hour whale watching cruise.
Expert educators from the Aquarium of the Pacific.
Multiple restrooms onboard.
Sealife Guarantee: Free return voucher if no marine life is seen.
State-of-the-art custom whale watching catamarans for comfort and stability.
Inside seating with climate control and large windows, plus outside seating.
Seasoned captains and crew with over 30 years of whale watching experience.


No food or drink included (available for purchase on board).
Parking not included (discount validation available at designated garages).
Booking and Confirmation Process
You will receive your booking information instantly via email. In the event that you do not receive our email, please check your spam folder, or log into your User Center to check your order status and download your voucher when available.
How To Use
Arrive at least 30 minutes in advance on weekdays, or 1 hour on weekends/holidays.
Boarding at Harbor Breeze Cruises Dock #2 (between Aquarium and Hooters, across from Bubba Gump).
Recommended parking at Aquarium or Pike garages, with $8 validated rate.
Whale watching cruise time limited to reserved slot.
Sealife Guarantee: Free voucher if no marine life seen.
Terms & Conditions
What is the cancellation policy?

Non-refundable reservations cannot be cancelled or modified once submitted.

What if you miss the appointed time or departure date?

Once the booking is confirmed, an absence or failure to show up on the scheduled date or time is a no-show. No refunds or reschedules will be issued for no-shows and late arrivals.

Other important information
Wheelchair and stroller accessible.
Service animals allowed.
Public transportation options nearby.
Free return voucher if no marine life spotted.
Marine life sightings not guaranteed.
Suitable for all fitness levels.
Arrive 30 minutes (weekdays) or 1 hour (weekends/holidays) before departure.
Parking not included; discount parking available with validation.
